Souscription de dette.texte: Debt markets were the largest contributor, with US$25.2 billion in first half fees, up 8% year-over-year.

Conseil en fusions et acquisitions.texte: M&A was a close second, with revenues from this segment rising 18% to US$24 billion.

Crédits syndiqués.texte: Syndicated lending activity also supplied US$17.3 billion in first half revenues, up 5% from last year.

Souscription d'actions.texte: Equity underwriting increased the most, as equity fees jumped 60% to US$13.5 billion, amid a revival in initial public offerings.
